# Catalog tabular property read fixture

Independently authored Platform XML 2.20 input for the read-only part of #1559.
It is not generated by the Unica writer. The section shape and the values
`ForItem`, `ForFolder`, `ForFolderAndItem` follow sections 6.2 and 26.1 of
`plugins/unica/references/specs/1c-config-objects-spec.md` (the shared Use value
dictionary is in section 6.1). This is a reader fixture, not proof of Designer
import or full platform validation.

`Lines` and `Notes` have different values, required flags and column types.
The generated type IDs, UUIDs and StandardAttribute subtree deliberately remain
in the original bytes: reading must preserve them without widening their
public projection or granting writer capabilities.
